# `aitbc auth logout`

Delete the stored coordinator credential for an environment.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc auth logout [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--environment` | text | `default` | no | Credential environment name |
| `--credential-name` | text | `client` | no | Credential name to delete |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc auth logout
```
